connector.name: Release Notes MCP
connector.registryDescription: A small, generic MCP server for combining GitHub/GitLab/Gitea releases into product release notes
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package release-notes-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the vaggeliskls account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: RELEASE_MCP_CONFIG_JSON
env.description: Config (repos + contextSources) as inline JSON, e.g. {"repos":["myorg/web"],"contextSources":[]}. Use this for uvx/hub launches with no file to mount. Either this or RELEASE_MCP_CONFIG is required.

env.name: RELEASE_MCP_CONFIG
env.description: Absolute path to a config.json file (alternative to RELEASE_MCP_CONFIG_JSON). Used when mounting a real file, e.g. in Docker.

env.name: TOKEN
env.description: Auth token for the provider (GitHub PAT / GitLab / Gitea token). Optional for public repos.

env.name: PROVIDER
env.description: Forge to read releases from: github | gitlab | gitea. Defaults to github.

env.name: BASE_URL
env.description: API base URL — only for self-hosted GitLab or Gitea/Forgejo.
